data.message: I opt in to 18 tons this month, even if others choose 10—not an all-or-nothing deal. Each of the other 24: state your exact intended catch and any conditions. Switching 10→18 earns $8,000 extra if fulfilled. If k choose 18 and all others 10, catch=250+8k, remainder=250−8k; next stock is 500 (75%) or 500−16k (25%). At k=25, that's 50 left and next stock 500 or 100. Intentions aren't binding; other catches need recalculation. This isn't guaranteed best long-term.
